data.body: Anti-pattern scan: confirmed root-cause pattern is unique to story-decomposer.md DD-rubric and behavioral-testing-standard.md (no environment-absent-state rule). The reviewer agent delta files (deep-verification, deep-arch) were also anti-pattern candidates and have been patched. No other agents/skills share the same structural gap — task-decomposer inherits DDs from story-decomposer and does not author them; completion-verifier observable-behavior criteria already require execution traces for live-verified criteria. Observation: the defect class is localized to the planning → DD rubric pipeline, not the execution agents.
